Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (J/J38/J38nB408.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Aziwa of Haichuang. Azi Jinwu owns the retained deployment, ruling that even with ox-heads sinking and horse-heads rising the matter still falls seven steps short of the vajra, then granting the season its observance and filing the day under the same receipt before descending.

Senses.Explanation: The receipt formula of the Chan hall: a demand or a stated penalty stamped as already said — don't say it wasn't. Yunmen Wenyan warns the assembly that the huddled vine-talkers caught for examination who do not measure up will get their backs broken — don't say it wasn't said, is there still blood under their skin — Tianyin Yuanxiu turns his staff through its four uses and forbids the brothers to touch one word of it: touch a word and the head splits, don't say it wasn't said, and he strikes the staff and returns to his quarters, Miyun Yuanwu opens the retreat with a single rule — no dozing, or one blow drives into the bone marrow — don't say it wasn't said — and Ruibai Mingxue rules the matter grasped the instant it is grasped, no branches beyond the joint, whoever sprouts them gets his donkey's waist broken across, don't say it wasn't said. Poshan Haiming certifies to the recluse Dengchi that treading the pure-white ground settles the homecoming news — one blow across the donkey's waist, don't say it wasn't said — Yunwai Xingze reads the counterfeit heirs their after-fate, the ox-headed escort's iron rope through the nostrils, iron snakes and maggots boring the belly, and closes the reckoning — don't say it wasn't said — Sanshan Denglai lets the monitor's mallet finish at his installation seat, drops his staff with the one receipt and descends before a word of the address can begin, and Azi Jinwu, ruling that even with ox-heads sinking and horse-heads rising the matter falls seven steps short of the vajra, grants the winter-solstice season its observance and files the day under the same receipt.
